title: rhobound.check/v1
description: What `rhobound check --json` prints: the data contract's verdict on one capture (DATA.md 3.14, 17, 19). Exit status 0 admitted (doubts listed), 4 refused, 2 tool error. With `--cut` and `--request-count F`, it is the verdict on the cut, checked with the count (DATA.md 6): `manifest_sha256` is the cut's manifest as that check completed it, and `ignored` is the read's, before the cut.

contract.description: the registry version the codes come from

findings.description: refusals first, then doubts, then notes

counts.description: occurrences of every code raised, not only those listed in findings

ignored.description: inputs declared ignored, by what (an attribute key, a file kind), with how many

manifest_sha256.description: the digest of the capture manifest the check read or wrote
